objective: Prototype an opt-in line-local justified-fit model from the already measured Word budget, preserving semantic source text and the existing J03/J04 checks.

sourceEvidence.finding: A line fits when compression is bounded by both 0.25 × inter-word gaps × U+0020 advance and approximately 0.36 × (last-word advance + one space); a uniform CSS word-spacing cannot express the second, line-local cap.

approaches.reason: Existing Word evidence already shows a single fraction cannot represent the last-word-dependent cap; another fitted fraction would repeat a falsified hypothesis.

approaches.status: MECHANISM_ONLY; renderer integration deferred; Word parity not established
approaches.model: Greedy candidate-line fit using font advances and Word's measured two-term compression budget; opt-in only.

budget.stopGate: Stop if the model cannot share line placement between editor and PDF while retaining editable semantic text without persisted measurement markup or forced line breaks.

b1.stopGate: Stop if the model cannot share line placement between editor and PDF while retaining editable semantic text without persisted measurement markup or forced line breaks.

roundResult: DEFERRED; no editor/PDF shared renderer or Word parity acceptance; research references only.
finalDecision: DEFER shared editor/PDF renderer integration; Phase 5.2 acceptance remains OPEN.
